in_marathi.name: Triloki
in_marathi.long_meaning: Triloki हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Triloki is a name derived from Hindu mythology, meaning 'Three-eyed God'. This name signifies the divine Trimurti, the three primary aspects of God in Hinduism: Brahma, the creator; Vishnu, the preserver; and Shiva, the destroyer. The three eyes represent wisdom, knowledge, and inner vision.
